name: Light Bridge
description: Connect matching orbs with bridges that never cross. Boards grow from 4 by 4 to 9 by 9, then add rocks, gems, length clues, bend counts, cross tiles and portals.

about.concept: Spatial planning under constraints. Matching orbs must be joined by bridges that never cross, so the child plans routes, looks ahead, and revises when two paths collide.
about.progression: Boards grow from 4 by 4 with two pairs in pre-K to 9 by 9 with many pairs by 4th grade. From 5th to 8th grade the rules grow instead: rocks block squares, a gem must be passed by its color, lights carry length clues, cross tiles let one bridge pass over another, portals jump a bridge across the board, and the top rungs ask for the fewest bends, which the app proves by search.
